messages:
lena: Quick check-in from the postmortem: we need to close action items and agree our external comms approach. Key things: status page line, 72h customer note, and policy for sharing full RCAs vs redacted summaries.

rishi: I'm happy to own the statuspage blurb. Proposing: "Intermittent elevated latency for Text Gen API from 02:109:40 UTC due to cache eviction during a model rollout. Rollback applied; remediation in progress. No customer data exposed." Thoughts?

kate: That reads fine. Add a one-line mitigation detail: "Rollback + throttling applied to stabilize nodes."

theo: Agree with tiered sharing: public summary + targeted expanded brief to affected accounts. Full internal RCA only on request with an NDA for deep technical details.

legal-bot: Legal: we recommend redacting internal IP and exact rollout orchestration steps from public copy. Can approve a redaction list if you post it here.

avery: Security confirms no evidence of data leak. We can include the "No customer data exposed" line.

ops-bot: Postmortem created: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/INC-2319999001

lena: Action items (owners + due ts):
- Rishi: finalize statuspage sentence and push to ProdOps (due 2319999020)
- Kate: draft 72h customer summary with TL;DR + FAQ (due 2319999060)
- Theo: draft enterprise brief template and outreach plan for affected accounts (due 2319999070)
- Legal: post redaction checklist here (due 2319999055)
- Security: final sign-off note (due 2319999050)

chad: I'll export affected-customer list and DM Kate.

rishi: Statuspage sentence posted to #statuspage-drafts and pinged ProdOps for push.

kate: Working on 72h note now. Will include timeline, impact metrics (errors/latency), and top-4 FAQs: 1) Data affected? 2) Root cause? 3) Mitigation? 4) Prevention plan.

lena: Recurring pattern note: similar cache-eviction incidents showed up in February. We should create an eng-runtime follow-up to add rollout throttles and eviction guardrails. Theo, can eng-runtime take a ticket?

theo: Yes. Eng-runtime will create ticket RUNTIME-752, prioritize P1 for guardrails, estimate in next sprint.

legal-bot: Redaction checklist: remove low-level orchestration commands, internal hostnames/IPs, customer identifiers, and any access-control logs. Post anything else you think is sensitive.

sec-team: Scans clear. Adding a short security addendum to the 72h note for customers who ask.

lena: Ok team. Kate will post the first draft here (reply in-thread). Once legal and security sign off, we publish public summary and send targeted briefs to impacted accounts. React with :white_check_mark: when done.

kate: First draft posted in-thread (see below). Will iterate after legal's redaction list.

lena: Closing this thread for now; reopen if blockers surface.
